name: MyAdNetwork
description: Self-hosted PHP advertising network and blogging platform.

DB_DATABASE.description: Nama database MySQL yang sudah dibuat.

DOMAIN_NAME.description: Domain publik tanpa path, misalnya myadnetwork.example.com.

PROVIDER_NAME.description: Nama identitas provider. Jika kosong, menggunakan APP_NAME.

PROVIDER_DOMAIN_URL.description: URL origin provider, misalnya https://myadnetwork.example.com. Jika kosong, dibuat dari DOMAIN_NAME.

SMTP_API_KEY.description: API key SMTP; opsional saat setup awal.

SMTP_API_SECRET.description: API secret SMTP; opsional saat setup awal.

NVIDIA_API_KEY.description: NVIDIA API key untuk semantic embedding.

PAYMENT_INFO.description: Informasi pembayaran; opsional saat setup awal.
